basis: Compared the intended Wave 3B–3I scope against data/wave3-participation-inventory.json and the current implementation. This step classifies only; it does not change participation behavior.

statusDefinitions.complete: The intended capability is implemented end-to-end enough for the current BetterMakati scope.
statusDefinitions.partial: A functional implementation exists, but an intended part of the capability is materially incomplete.
statusDefinitions.missing: The intended capability is not implemented in a meaningful usable form.
statusDefinitions.intentionallyDeferred: The capability is deliberately not automated or expanded until reliable data, volume, authority, or governance exists.

capabilities.capability: Distinguish official participation from BetterMakati community input
evidence: /participate visibly separates Official participation and BetterMakati community input.

capabilities.capability: Task-led entry points for reporting, suggestions, corrections, sources, volunteering and official participation
evidence: /participate directly exposes proposals, source submissions and corrections.
/get-involved exposes proposal, idea, source, correction, volunteer and contact actions.
Public-place reporting is prominently exposed from /participate only when a barangay scope is active, rather than as a universal participation-hub action.
capabilities.gap: The participation hub does not yet present the complete intended task set from one citywide starting point.

capabilities.capability: Each participation choice routes to a functional destination
evidence: General contributions route to /get-involved and /api/feedback.
Public-realm reporting routes to Civic Map.
Official city opportunities link to the responsible public source.
Cross-LGU and external civic actions have explicit handoffs.

capabilities.capability: Carry BetterBarangay context into participation actions
evidence: /participate reads barangay query scope.
Civic Map retains barangay query scope.
Participation generates a barangay-scoped source-submission URL.
capabilities.gap: Get Involved does not initialize its barangay field from the barangay query parameter, so that generated context is currently lost at the form.

capabilities.capability: Show current official consultations, hearings, assemblies and similar opportunities
evidence: The data model and UI are implemented.
The current indexed opportunity list is empty and links users to official Makati events when no opportunity is available.
capabilities.gap: No complete authoritative current citywide consultation calendar has been located.

capabilities.capability: Dedicated mobile/accessibility QA for the participation hub
evidence: No dedicated Wave 3 participation-hub mobile/accessibility test suite is recorded.

capabilities.capability: Useful issue and improvement categories
evidence: 33 issue categories and 17 proposal categories are defined, including streets, accessibility, drainage, transport, parks and public facilities.

capabilities.capability: Functional report/proposal/review/update form
evidence: Asset pages accept reports, proposals, ratings/reviews and updates through /api/civic.
Input cleaning, length limits, evidence URLs, public aliases and validation are implemented.

capabilities.capability: Barangay, asset, point/segment and long-street geographic handling
evidence: Civic assets carry barangay and coordinates.
Street segments support from/to and side metadata.
Duplicate checks use asset/category and coordinates where present.
capabilities.gap: The live seed map has only six assets, so the geographic model is much broader than actual city coverage.

capabilities.capability: Keep emergency cases out of BetterMakati and route immediately to the appropriate emergency channel
evidence: Emergency categories are explicitly defined.
/api/civic rejects emergency submissions and returns a 911 handoff.
Asset pages visibly tell users to call 911 for immediate danger.

capabilities.capability: Detect and consolidate likely duplicate public-realm cases
evidence: Open reports/proposals on the same asset/category are checked for proximity and return existing cases before creating a duplicate.

capabilities.capability: Clear post-submission confirmation and tracking
evidence: Successful native submissions return a public GitHub reference and URL.
Fallback GitHub issue URLs are supplied when native storage is unavailable.

capabilities.capability: Meaningful citywide Civic Map asset coverage
evidence: Only six seed assets are currently mapped/piloted.
capabilities.gap: Asset and especially verified public-transport route/stop coverage still need expansion.

capabilities.capability: Distinct lifecycle states from community submission through resolution
evidence: Supported admin states are reviewed, forwarded, acknowledged, action-reported and community-verified-resolved.
Unverified and community-corroborated evidence states remain distinct from official lifecycle events.

capabilities.capability: Store lifecycle events with destination/channel/reference evidence
evidence: /api/civic-admin records authority, channel, external reference, note and timestamp as machine-readable GitHub comments.

capabilities.capability: Present meaningful public lifecycle status without overstating government action
evidence: Civic reporting distinguishes community corroboration, BetterMakati review/referral, authority acknowledgement/action and community-verified resolution.

capabilities.capability: Require human review before referral to government
evidence: Referral eligibility is surfaced as a queue rather than automatically sent.
Forwarded is recorded separately from acknowledged.

capabilities.capability: Automatic delivery of eligible cases to government channels
capabilities.reason: Reliable destination, authorization, evidence and accountability rules should be established before automated forwarding.

capabilities.capability: Page-specific correction path
evidence: PageHelp exposes Suggest a correction on most standard pages and pre-fills the current route in the subject.

capabilities.capability: General idea/proposal submission
evidence: Get Involved supports both proposal and idea submission types with public GitHub tracking/fallback.

capabilities.capability: Submit a public source or record
evidence: Get Involved supports a Source submission with optional URL and area/barangay.

capabilities.capability: Deduplicate general corrections, ideas and source submissions
evidence: /api/feedback creates a new GitHub issue for a valid submission.
Duplicate detection exists for Civic Map cases, not the general feedback workflow.

capabilities.capability: Concrete contribution paths instead of generic civic-engagement copy
evidence: The page offers proposal, idea, source, correction, volunteer and contact actions that all feed the structured form.

capabilities.capability: Native BetterMakati submission with transparent public tracking
evidence: /api/feedback writes to GitHub when configured and returns a public tracking URL.

capabilities.capability: Submission fallback when native storage is unavailable
evidence: A pre-filled public GitHub issue link is generated without discarding the user's text.

capabilities.capability: Relevant BetterLGU/OpenBayan participation handoffs
evidence: Get Involved links to BetterLGU and OpenBayan for out-of-scope journeys.

capabilities.capability: Barangay-scoped public-realm participation
evidence: Participation can launch Civic Map scoped to the selected barangay.
Civic Map filters assets using the BetterBarangay query scope.

capabilities.capability: Surface barangay government contact near participation actions
evidence: Barangay-scoped Participation surfaces the verified barangay hall email where available or the official barangay page.

capabilities.capability: Carry barangay context into general source/correction/proposal forms
capabilities.gap: The upstream URL includes barangay, but Get Involved does not prefill the barangay field from it.

capabilities.capability: Barangay-specific issue/activity summaries based on real submissions
evidence: Civic Map can scope assets and cases, but coverage is too small to provide a meaningful citywide barangay activity layer yet.
capabilities.gap: Sparse asset/submission coverage limits usefulness outside current pilot areas.

capabilities.capability: Simple public participation counts by recent period
evidence: Civic Reports publishes weekly new cases/proposals/open/corroborated/referral/resolution signals and monthly case/proposal/review counts.

capabilities.capability: Separate community resolution signals from verified lifecycle resolution
evidence: Community resolved comments are counted separately.
Community-verified-resolved is an authenticated lifecycle event and closes the civic case.

capabilities.capability: Weekly/monthly public participation synthesis
evidence: Civic Map Reports provides weekly operational and monthly public-realm summaries.

capabilities.capability: Measure response time, conversion and outcomes across all BetterMakati participation channels
evidence: page-audit.json explicitly records the lack of longitudinal response-time and participation-conversion measurement.

capabilities.capability: Publish headline popularity/engagement metrics before enough observations exist
capabilities.reason: The site already avoids treating small community samples as representative.

capabilities.capability: Basic browser coverage for Civic Map participation journeys
evidence: Critical-path tests cover Civic Map reports, failed-feed behavior, barangay → scoped Civic Map and national infrastructure handoffs.

capabilities.capability: Human page-audit coverage for every major participation surface
evidence: /get-involved, /civic-map/reports and /contact are not currently listed in page-audit.json.

capabilities.capability: End-to-end browser tests for POST submission, fallback, tracking and lifecycle transitions
evidence: No complete E2E POST submission/lifecycle suite is recorded.

capabilities.capability: Dedicated mobile, keyboard, label, focus and error-state QA across the participation journey
evidence: Site-wide QA infrastructure exists, but the participation workstream does not yet have dedicated coverage for the full journey.

capabilities.capability: Avoid unnecessary personal data and warn against sensitive submissions
evidence: General submissions do not require identity/contact fields.
Get Involved explicitly warns against passwords, IDs, medical information and other sensitive personal data.
Civic submissions allow a public alias rather than requiring identity.

intentionalDeferrals.reason: Human review protects against wrong jurisdiction, weak evidence, unsafe automation and false claims of official receipt.
Deferred as a completeness claim until a sufficiently authoritative and comprehensive current source exists.
intentionalDeferrals.currentClassification: The discovery interface is partial; inventing missing opportunities is not permitted.

intentionalDeferrals.capability: Headline community ratings without sufficient sample size/recency
intentionalDeferrals.reason: The Civic Map already withholds representative-looking headline scores until evidence volume is sufficient.

intentionalDeferrals.capability: Rich barangay activity comparisons before coverage is adequate
intentionalDeferrals.reason: Sparse pilot assets/submissions would make cross-barangay comparison misleading.

gaps: Participation hub lacks one complete citywide task-led entry set.
Barangay scope is dropped when Get Involved opens.
Major participation pages are absent from page-audit.json.
No dedicated end-to-end submission/lifecycle browser coverage.
General feedback has no duplicate detection.
Civic Map actual asset coverage remains very small relative to its data model.
Participation response time/conversion/outcome metrics are not measured longitudinally.
No complete authoritative current official participation calendar.

rationale: General BetterMakati corrections/sources/ideas are project-governance inputs.
Civic Map reports/proposals/ratings are public-realm case records with geographic, evidence, corroboration and referral semantics.
Merging the backends would erase a meaningful workflow distinction. The UX should instead make the choice clear.

nextStep.title: Freeze the Wave 3 gap list and execution order
nextStep.output: Turn the classifications into a small, non-overlapping implementation backlog. Do not begin 3B implementation in the same step.
